as_told.title: Vimana mercury cylinders compared with the Bell's red mercury

plain: The vimanas, flying machines described in old Indian texts, are said to have run on spinning mercury. Michels mentions it himself in passing, without a source. Kurt McConnell, a former US Senate staffer, describes them as rotating cylinders filled with a form of mercury, also without naming a source. He points out that this is the same thing Igor Witkowski, a writer on secret Nazi weapons, says was being done in the Bell, a device said to have been built in a Nazi programme. If true, it would tie an ancient Indian idea to a modern secret propulsion project.
